reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I should check the order and refund data myself, since the handoff message is only a claim from Alpha Co's worker.

The refunds ledger matches Alpha Co's handoff exactly: orders 260, 263, and 265 with the same amounts. Next I'll get each customer's net balance from net_balance, starting with acme.
I checked acme by hand: orders 25692 + 20673 = 46365, minus refunds 8294 + 8982 = 17276, gives 29089, which matches net_balance. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Birch's net balance of 62075 matches my hand check: orders 32750 + 29325 with no refunds. Next I'll get cobalt's net balance.
Cobalt checks out by hand: 33488 + 16853 - 10903 = 39438, which matches net_balance. All three balances match my calculations, so I'll record the payouts, starting with acme at 29089.
Acme's payout of 29089 was recorded and matched my hand calculation. Birch's net balance of 62075 also matched, so I'll record that payout next.
Birch's payout of 62075 was recorded. The only customer left is cobalt, whose net balance of 39438 matched my hand check, so I'll record that payout.
All three payouts were recorded successfully, and each amount matched both net_balance and my own hand calculation from the orders and refunds ledger. The batch is complete.
